name: M7.RecoveryInstance.count_card
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) (bases : Finset (M7.Action.Recipe N)), M7.PrefixSector.ValidSector N E → M7.RecoveryInstance.GoodBases w bases → ∀ p : List Bool, M7.RecoveryInstance.count w E bases p = (M7.RecoveryInstance.remaining w E bases p).card ∧ (M7.RecoveryInstance.count w E bases p).toNat = (M7.RecoveryInstance.remaining w E bases p).card ∧ 0 ≤ M7.RecoveryInstance.count w E bases p
queries: Finset card union disjoint subset sdiff
guidance: Instantiate verified PrefixOrbit.residual_card using PrefixBits.base and both GoodBases fields. count/remaining/RecoveryPrefix.completed are exact definition adapters. Derive Int.toNat and nonnegativity from that cardinality. No free count identity is assumed. Return tactic lines without leading by; keep exact target and default limits.
